name: Speed Demon makes Suffuse grant 20% movement speed (#1223)
contract: Speed Demon 707232 reads 'Your Suffuse now increases your movement speed by 20%' (bindmysoul.com/conquest/talents.normalized.json, fetchedAt 2026-07-22T23:10:31.369Z). Suffuse (801063) claims its previously inert effect index 2 as the native aura 31 (SPELL_AURA_MOD_INCREASE_SPEED), targeted at the caster; aura_ascension_xoroth_lifecycle::Calculate (AscensionXorothAuras.cpp) sets that effect's amount to Speed Demon's own tooltip value only while the caster has aura 707232, and to 0 otherwise, so the bonus exists only for the duration Suffuse itself is applied. Speed Demon's own raw effect (a SPELLMOD_EFFECT3 flat modifier targeting the same then-inert slot) is nulled in ApplyContracts to avoid a redundant native spellmod contribution. Suffuse is a Spender ability gated on Demonfire (500906) stacks; set_aura forces those stacks directly, matching Chop Shop's (#486) established pattern.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
SETUP: baseline run speed is unmodified
Set Demonfire to the 6-stack cap so Suffuse is castable
SETUP: Suffuse landed without Speed Demon
BASELINE: Suffuse alone does not change movement speed
Force the Speed Demon passive aura
SETUP: the Speed Demon passive is active
Let the fresh Suffuse application recompute its speed effect
SETUP: Suffuse is active with Speed Demon known
CONTRACT: movement speed rises by ~20% while Suffuse is active
